new_result.statement: For any probability law Omega on nonzero square physical minors of variable order, with I-side row marginals <=1/2 and mean order kbar>2, defining K=exp(E log det^2 + H), the full conditioned quadratic form satisfies ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2 sqrt(e) kbar/(kbar-2) K^(-1/(2 kbar)); its density is continuous and vanishes at infinity.
new_result.heavy_row_corollary: If the natural 3-volume law has row i mass alpha and every conditional co-marginal a_k<=1/2, then a self-matched natural-on-pairs 2-minor law yields K_mix>=2 alpha Z/||r_i|| and ||p_Q||_infinity<=10 sqrt(e)[2 alpha Z/||r_i||]^(-1/5).
new_result.partner_applied: account02/B01 r31 e2(N^T N)>=alpha Z/||r_i||^2 used in Corollary 2A; Corollary 2B strengthens the same inequality by matching conditional row-pair weights directly.
